annotations.title: EU Geographical Indications (PDO / PGI / TSG) Single Regulation Audit

description:
[EU geographical indications (PDO / PGI / TSG) single regulation audit. Statutory compliance check, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits protected designations under Regulation (EU) 2024/1143, evaluating raw material zoning restrictions, transformation criteria, control body accreditation, and Article 26 evocation risks.
Usage: Pass product indication details and geographical provenance to audit legal validity of PDO, PGI, or TSG claims.
Returns: JSON object with { productName: string, indicationType: string, registeredDenominationName: string, isPdoCriterionSatisfied: boolean, isPgiCriterionSatisfied: boolean, isTsgCriterionSatisfied: boolean, evocationOrMisleadingRiskDetected: boolean, statutoryAuditVerdict: string, complianceFindings: array }.

claimsTraditionalSpecialityRecipe.description: Whether product follows traditional practice of at least 30 years (mandatory for TSG)

countryOfOriginIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code of Member State holding the registration

indicationType.description: Type of geographical indication protection claimed

inspectionBodyCertificationCode.description: Accredited control authority code assigned by Member State (e.g. IT-BIO-006, CSQA)

packagingMentionsOtherGeographicalHints.description: Whether packaging references flags, places, or terms other than the registered denomination (Art. 26 evocation check)

processingAllInDesignatedZone.description: Whether all stages of transformation take place in the delimited zone (mandatory for PDO, at least 1 stage for PGI)

productSpecificationComplianceCertified.description: Whether product complies with registered disciplinary specification (Disciplinare di Produzione)

rawMaterialsOriginRestrictedToZone.description: Whether 100% of raw materials originate strictly within delimited geographical zone (mandatory for PDO)

registeredDenominationName.description: Official protected denomination registered in eAmbrosia (e.g. Parmigiano Reggiano, Champagne, Prosciutto di Parma)

name: geographical_indication_pdo_pgi_audit
title: EU Geographical Indications (PDO / PGI / TSG) Single Regulation Audit
